scope: actual current built workspace and real model/forms; isolated VM storage only

tests.name: explicit discard removes only that followup draft and never restores discarded values
continue editing preserves the current draft and never closes the active form
current correction excludes disabled category references but sealed history still displays their original definitions
unknown request handoff uses independent review context and submits its exact request identity
review context failure shows an error and never constructs an empty apparently successful handoff form
assigned reviewer can inspect a minimal inbox and reconcile without business detail or private result rendering
different template nodes with repeated local node IDs are rejected before opening a bulk assignment form
changed form inputs and refreshed current-value differences always clear prior confirmation
fresh AI detail reload prepares the scene directory before opening start, while non-AI start remains independent
scope changes while preparing AI scenes never construct a stale start dialog or execute the old tenant record
